players.product: HVLP high-frequency / high-speed electrodeposited copper foil (HVLP1-4 in volume supply, HVLP5 in development) for copper-clad laminate (CCL) and PCB makers

quarterly_data.quarter: Anhui Tongguan Copper Foil results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual (05-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chairman Gan Guoqing (results briefing): Q1 2026 revenue was RMB 18.42 hundred million and net profit RMB 10,634.71 ten-thousand. Board secretary and finance head Wang Junlin said accounts receivable stood at RMB 14.10 hundred million at end-March 2026; foil is priced as copper price plus processing fee so copper moves pass through to selling prices, and the company also hedges with commodity futures.
quarterly_data.figure: Q1 2026 revenue RMB 18.42 hundred million; net profit RMB 10,634.71 ten-thousand

quarterly_data.quarter: Anhui Tongguan Copper Foil results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual (05-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: HVLP status (2025 annual results briefing): chairman Gan Guoqing said the company has arranged customer supply for the full HVLP1 to HVLP4 series, with HVLP2 currently the main product shipped; board secretary Wang Junlin said HVLP5 foil is in development and has broken through key performance indicators, that overseas revenue comes mainly through processing trade with Taiwan-invested customers, and that capacity and mix for high-end products will be adjusted to order demand. The chairman said IC-package carrier copper foil is in technology development and industrialisation.
